text:
maya: Hey team :wave: opening a docs PR to update the hello-world quickstart for SDK v4 auth flow. Need a quick sanity check on the deploy steps & Dockerfile instructions. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

samir: On it. What's the breaking change here?

maya: Main changes: env var renamed to REDWOOD_API_KEY (was API_TOKEN), and we removed the auto-build step in the quickstart. Need explicit `docker build` + run examples and to update the sample run command.

leo: Can you paste the minimal snippet you want in the tutorial? I'll validate.

maya: Sure — new recommended snippet:
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-xxxx
python -m example_app
```
and the minimal Python auth call:
```python
import os
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.generate('hello')
```

docs-bot: PR opened: #842 — status: needs-review — labels added: docs/quickstart, needs-triage

ron: I'll do a lint + link sweep. Also flagging that the 'first deployment' paragraph still references `docker run -p 8080:8080` — the sample app now serves on 3000.

maya: Good catch — updated README in the branch to show `-p 3000:3000`. Also noticed a stray comment mentioning SDK3 in comments — doing a search/replace in the branch.

samir: :thumbsup: I'll approve after I can run the sample locally. Minor tip: use `os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY')` in the snippet to avoid KeyError in examples.

leo: Ran the container; hit a missing dependency (`aiohttp`) in the server example. I pushed a small patch to requirements.txt on the same branch.

maya: Added `pip install -r requirements.txt` to the quickstart steps and a short note about minimal dependencies. Can someone take the 'auth troubleshooting' microguide and tidy two small Q/A entries?

ron: Taking the microguide. I'll propose: 1) "env var not found" and 2) "403 from API" short checks.

samir: If CI looks green, can we merge after ~24h window for canary testers? label: semver-patch?

maya: Tagging @docs-squad for visibility. deploy-bot: will the docs site build automatically on merge?

deploy-bot: docs-site build queued for PR #842 — ETA ~6m. CI hook triggered on push.

leo: CI passed locally for me; GH actions flaky earlier, re-ran the workflow.

samir: LGTM with one nit: prefer f-strings in the inline example instead of `%` formatting.

maya: Switched examples to f-strings and pushed the small change. Final tiny edits done. Anyone for final review?

ron: Approving now. :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks — merging in 30m unless objections.

deploy-bot: PR merged and deployed to staging docs site: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/quickstart/hello-world — monitoring build logs.

leo: Spot-checked the staging page — examples render cleanly, code fences good.

samir: Nice. Will follow up after 24h for production deploy schedule.

maya: Great work, everyone. Closing the loop once prod deploy is scheduled.
